# Figures for FITB Fiscal 2008

- **November 2008 (Shares Purchased (a))**: 7,526 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total (Shares Purchased (a))**: 32,960 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **October 2008 (Maximum Shares that May Be Purchased Under the Plans or Programs)**: 19,201,518 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **December 2008 (Maximum Shares that May Be Purchased Under the Plans or Programs)**: 19,201,518 shares (Source: documents/report.md)

## Portion of Total Purchased Shares Purchased During November 2008

To calculate the portion of the total purchased shares that were purchased during November 2008:

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{November 2008 Shares Purchased}}{\text{Total Shares Purchased}} = \frac{7,526}{32,960} \approx 0.2284 \]

This means approximately 22.84% of the total purchased shares were purchased during November 2008.

# Figures for FITB Fiscal 2008

- **November 2008 (Shares Purchased (a))**: 7,526 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total (Shares Purchased (a))**: 32,960 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **October 2008 (Maximum Shares that May Be Purchased Under the Plans or Programs)**: 19,201,518 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **December 2008 (Maximum Shares that May Be Purchased Under the Plans or Programs)**: 19,201,518 shares (Source: documents/report.md)

## Portion of Total Purchased Shares Purchased During November 2008

To calculate the portion of the total purchased shares that were purchased during November 2008:

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{November 2008 Shares Purchased}}{\text{Total Shares Purchased}} = \frac{7,526}{32,960} \approx 0.2284 \]

This means approximately 22.84% of the total purchased shares were purchased during November 2008.

# Figures from FITB Fiscal 2008 Annual Report

- **November 2008 (Shares Purchased (a))**: 7,526 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total (Shares Purchased (a))**: 32,960 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **October 2008 (Maximum Shares that May Be Purchased Under the Plans or Programs)**: 19,201,518 shares (Source: documents/report.md)
- **December 2008 (Maximum Shares that May Be Purchased Under the Plans or Programs)**: 19,201,518 shares (Source: documents/report.md)

## Portion of Total Purchased Shares Purchased During November 2008

To calculate the portion of the total purchased shares that were purchased during November 2008:

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{November 2008 Shares Purchased}}{\text{Total Shares Purchased}} = \frac{7,526}{32,960} \approx 0.2283 \]

This means approximately 22.83% of the total purchased shares were purchased during November 2008.

To calculate the portion of the total purchased shares that were purchased during November 2008:

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{November 2008 Shares Purchased}}{\text{Total Shares Purchased}} = \frac{7,526}{32,960} \approx 0.2283 \]

This means approximately 22.83% of the total purchased shares were purchased during November 2008.
